Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State, and perused material on record.

This application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed to direct the learned Civil Judge (Junior Division), Fast Track Court, Crime Against Women, Kanpur Nagar for early disposal of Case No.205866 of 2022 (State Vs. Kuldeep @ Deepak and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 10 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 & 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Kanpur Nagar, pending in the court of learned Civil Judge (Junior Division), Fast Track Court, Crime Against Women, Kanpur Nagar within stipulated period.
